title: Syrian-Style Grilled Cheese Flatbread
description: A simple and flavorful flatbread dish topped with melted cheese, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
Butter one side of each flatbread sheet.
Place one flatbread sheet, buttered side down, on the grill.
Top with a slice of Syrian cheese.
Place another flatbread sheet, buttered side up, on top of the cheese.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Flip the flatbread over and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make 3 more flatbreads.
